summary: The Joint Corp filed an 8-K reporting an October 1, 2026 Asset Purchase Agreement to reacquire regional development rights for its Texas region from The Joint Franchises San Antonio, DFW, Houston and Austin LLCs and Texas Ltd., controlled by David and Anne Glover, terminating the related regional developer agreements. Consideration is $8.0 million cash paid at execution plus up to $2.0 million contingent on gross-sales metrics over two annual periods beginning September 1, 2026. The sellers retain eight franchised Texas clinics; the region had 141 franchised clinics and generated roughly $2.3 million of trailing royalties. Watch contingent-payment triggers and franchisee transition risk.
